CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliations (id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, transfer_no text NOT NULL, branch text NOT NULL, driver text NOT NULL, doc_date text NOT NULL, payload text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL, created text NOT NULL, updated text NOT NULL, version integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, revision_token text NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reconciliations_transfer_no_unique ON reconciliations (transfer_no)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_keys (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, group_id text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoice_keys (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, group_id text NOT NULL)
